$comment: Example zdd/config.json for a Next.js + Supabase repo. Values only — nothing here is required beyond 'extractors'; every path shown under 'paths' is already the default. Compose extractors per convention: a FastAPI + Supabase repo lists ["supabase", "fastapi"]; a stack with no extractor yet lists ["generic"]. An extractorOptions block is only read when its extractor is listed — the 'fastapi' block below is inert here.
name: My App

agentIndex.summary: One-line orientation for an agent landing in this repo.

viewer.$comment: Which viewer renders human-index.html from graph.json; omit for cytoscape with no options, or write "viewer": "minimal". nonAreaTags lives at the top level because it shapes graph.json, not just the viewer.
viewer.name: cytoscape
